items.quote: And the people thirsted there for water
items.claim: The Israelites experienced thirst in the wilderness during the Exodus journey

items.quote: the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
items.claim: The people attributed thirst as the physical mechanism by which they and their livestock would be killed

items.quote: they be almost ready to stone me
items.claim: The people threatened stoning as a mechanism of violence against Moses
